summary.text: Terry Kilgore is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 45th District since 1994.
The district covers the Counties of Lee, Scott and Wise, part of Dickenson County, and the City of Norton.
The House profile lists Terry Kilgore as House Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Terry Kilgore was born in Kingsport, TN.
The profile lists a B.A. from Clinch Valley College (1983) and a J.D. from the Marshall-Wythe School of Law at the College of William and Mary in Virginia (1986).
Terry Kilgore's listed occupation is attorney.
The profile lists the Methodist Church under memberships and affiliations.
Terry Kilgore serves on the Rules, Labor and Commerce, and Courts of Justice committees.
